mostWorthwhile.text: Preparing the wick and fitting it to lettuce felt like a practical way to keep roots supplied while conserving power.

leastWorthwhile.text: The lamp assembly and mounting were predictable and provided little detail beyond the item names.

surprise.text: I was mildly curious that the two beds used different watering arrangements, but the results did not explain why.

arbitrary.text: The compatibility list directed the wick to lettuce and the circulator to potatoes; I could follow it, but did not understand why those particular pairings were necessary.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the frozen discovery and the storm develop, although this chapter's straightforward maintenance alone did not strongly motivate me.
